price.note: Verified minimum purchase price from the public product purchase panel. The original and sale prices are USD; no currency conversion or full-archive download was performed.

license.name: Creator license
license.note: The creator permits royalty-free use in personal and commercial projects, with credit to composer Elektrobear. Separate redistribution or resale rights are not stated.

expiryNote: Exact UTC expiry read from the first-party product JSON-LD Offer.priceValidUntil. Its sale price and currency agree with the visible purchase panel.
productNote: Public product description, purchase panel, download-file list, creator licensing terms and marketplace Product/Offer structured data were reviewed. A publisher-listed collection of 80 tracks for $10, with 5.0/5 from 32 marketplace ratings and explicit commercial project use. Useful breadth for projects needing several music cues; composer credit is required. Paid files and publisher images were not downloaded.
